mapper.select:
select f.finprod_id as id, f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':' || nvl(f.finprod_abbr, f.finprod_name) as text from fin_product f, fin_product_type t where f.finprod_id = t.finprod_id /*add by czj 20210531 增加一级市场债*/ and t.type_8 IN ('F01', 'F06', 'F03','F17')
AND ( f.finprod_id like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or nvl(f.finprod_abbr, f.finprod_name) like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
AND f.finprod_id = #{initValue}
ORDER BY nvl(f.finprod_abbr, f.finprod_name)

select a.*, t1.finprodName, t1.assetType, t2.SPPI_TEST_ID as SPPI_TEST_ID2, t2.FINPROD_ID as FINPROD_ID2, t2.QUESTION_NO as QUESTION_NO2, t2.ANSWER_TYPE as ANSWER_TYPE2, t2.ANSWER_VALUE as ANSWER_VALUE2, t2.REMARK as REMARK2, t2.CREATE_USER as CREATE_USER2, t2.CREATE_DEPT as CREATE_DEPT2, t2.CREATE_TIME as CREATE_TIME2, t2.UPDATE_USER as UPDATE_USER2, t2.UPDATE_TIME as UPDATE_TIME2 from sppi_test a left join (select f.finprod_id, nvl(f.finprod_abbr, f.finprod_name) as finprodName, t.type_8 as assetType from fin_product f, fin_product_type t where f.finprod_id = t.finprod_id and f.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*add by czj 20210531 增加一级市场债*/ and t.type_8 IN ('F01', 'F06', 'F03','F17') ) t1 on t1.finprod_id = a.finprod_id left join sppi_test_qa t2 on a.sppi_test_id = t2.sppi_test_id and a.finprod_id = t2.finprod_id where a.sppi_test_id = #{sppiTestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(1) from trd_product_deal d where d.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d.trade_status <> '03' and d.is_cancel = 'N'

select sid.BOND_ID bondId, sid.BOND_ABBR bondAbbr, sid.IS_SPPI_PASS isSppiPass, sid.REASON reason, sid.BID_PRICE_CON bidPriceCon, sid.COST_VALUE costValue, sid.OTHER_CONDITION otherCondition, sid.IMPORT_DATE importDate, '中债' dataSource, fpt.type_8 assetType from SPPI_IMPORT_DATA sid LEFT JOIN fin_product_type fpt on sid.BOND_ID = fpt.finprod_id where BOND_ID = #{finprodId}

select t1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, case when nvl(t1.sppi_test_status, '0') = '0' and a.test_status is null then '0' when nvl(t1.sppi_test_status, '0') = '0' and a.test_status is not null then '1' else t1.sppi_test_status end as sppiTestStatus, t1.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr from fin_product t1 left join (select x.*, row_number() over(partition BY x.finprod_id order by x.update_time DESC) as rowno from sppi_test x) a on t1.finprod_id = a.finprod_id and a.rowno = 1 where (t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(#{finprodId},'%')) AND (t1.Finprod_Type2 in (#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F01}, #{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F32}))
